hook: Visual wheel and mood notes are shareable. | A clear, intuitive target to hit.
risk: Cycle phase calls are retrospective; overconfident lessons. | Players may not grasp coverage; add a live hit tally.
panel_note: Season of Brier on cycle phase; coverage tally hint mismatched

name: Sunday Review
loop: Weekly review round re-asks your worst-calibrated questions with fresh masked trades; friends cheer progress.
hook: Improvement is the hook.
risk: Cheerleading may feel patronising.
panel_note: Weekly review of own misses; gentle

name: Crowd Versus You + Sixty Second Sage meta
loop: Everyone sets a probability for the same masked path, and the daily board ranks calibration, not wins, with a minimum of ten days to appear. Meta from WC-031: Log-score blitz: ten masked charts in one minute, where overconfident wrong answers cost heavily and fifty-fifty hedges are safe.
hook: Fair, noise-resistant ranking that mirrors the app's lower-bound rule.
risk: Slow to feel rewarding; show personal curve early. | Log loss is opaque; needs plain-language explanation.
panel_note: Ten-day minimum board plus log blitz; global leaderboard

name: Dial A Duration / Number Line Guess
loop: Dial how long the trend continues before turning, in bars; scoring is a distance penalty; reveal marks the turning bar with a pin.
hook: Timing predictions feel different from direction guesses. | Calibration puzzle with a score that is easy to understand.
risk: Continuous scoring can be opaque; show the distance in plain terms. | Statistics jargon; use plain wording.
panel_note: Duration dial distance penalty is opaque but novel

name: Era Guesser + Rolling Rating Window meta
loop: Study a masked path and place probability sliders across four candidate eras (inflation, boom, panic, drift); scored on how much weight the true era got. Meta from LS-013: No hard seasons; rating is a rolling ninety-day calibration window so old results fade smoothly and recent form shows.
hook: Calibration meets trivia; leaderboard of best era detectives.
risk: Leaderboard rewarding trivia more than trading skill. | Unlimited play may encourage cherry-picking sessions.
panel_note: Four-era probability spread scored by true era weight; rolling window

name: Season With Seeded Chaos / Fan Club Pools
loop: A friend league runs a season on generated paths whose rules the league votes on weekly, such as fatter tails or jumps, labelled synthetic.
hook: Governance fun; the group shapes the game. | Aligns fandom with calibration.
risk: Synthetic skill may not transfer; label clearly. | Trader pressure; allow pausing pools.
panel_note: League-voted synthetic tail rules; neat governance, weekly

name: Fog Of Candles
loop: A masked chart runs to a cutoff; swipe right for up, left for down over the next segment; the hidden future wipes in with a reveal animation; 15 cards per round.
hook: Fast swipes, instant reveal, and a calibration score that rewards honest confidence.
risk: Endless rapid loops can feel slot-like; needs session caps and no frequency rewards.
panel_note: Fog swipe with rating; swipe lacks confidence, unlimited needs caps

name: Tape Reader Duel
loop: Send a friend a link to the same 10 masked cards; each plays on their own time; the app shows a head-to-head calibration comparison afterwards.
hook: Async duels travel by link, no scheduling.
risk: Challenge links are growth hooks; no spam prompts or contact import.
panel_note: Async same-ten duel with Brier comparison; no scheduling, watch invite spam

name: Lesson Ladder
loop: A lesson tree from trend basics to risk and calibration; each node is two minutes of masked examples and a mastery check.
hook: Clear path with a sense of progress.
risk: Dryness; may need narrative wrapper.
panel_note: Safe educational ladder; weak scoring

name: Fog Of Candles
loop: A masked chart runs to a cutoff; swipe right for up, left for down over the next segment; the hidden future wipes in with a reveal animation; 15 cards per round.
hook: Fast swipes, instant reveal, and a calibration score that rewards honest confidence.
risk: Endless rapid loops can feel slot-like; needs session caps and no frequency rewards.
panel_note: Fog swipe without progression; thin replay hook, cheap and safe

name: Twin Timeline
loop: Both players drag a range for where the price will land at the end of the same seeded path; narrower correct ranges beat wider ones.
hook: Rewards precision and humility together.
risk: Intervals may be gamed by always-wide; score width and coverage jointly.
panel_note: Seeded range duel with joint width and coverage; synthetic data keeps it safe

name: Jury Of Charts
loop: Everyone gets the same 10 masked cards each day; swipe your calls; your rank vs the field is shown after the day closes, with calibration as a tiebreaker.
hook: Same-cards-for-all creates water-cooler comparison.
risk: Rank pressure; show percentiles with confidence ranges.
panel_note: Ten swipes daily with rank; swipe cannot feed coverage

name: Boss Rush Daily + Sandbox Sketchbook meta
loop: A once-a-day seeded run of five masked boss charts; everyone gets the same seed, shares a pip grid, and tomorrow brings a new seed. Meta from PR-086: Create your own prediction card by drawing a chart and a hidden path from presets; friends solve it via link; creators get coverage stats only.
hook: Shared seed gives conversation, not compulsion.
risk: Share card may overclaim skill; add disclaimer. | User content moderation burden; restrict to synthetic presets.
panel_note: Daily seed plus user-made synthetic cards; moderation burden

name: Milestone Seasons / Season With Seeded Chaos
loop: Every fourth season is a special anniversary season that mixes every previous theme; the recap card compares your first and latest calibration.
hook: Long-term arc and a payoff for staying. | Governance fun; the group shapes the game.
risk: Retention hook; no penalty for skipping seasons. | Synthetic skill may not transfer; label clearly.
panel_note: Anniversary recap compares first vs latest calibration

name: Lighthouse Weeks
loop: Each week a masked path with one lighthouse event; friends drag ranges before it, and the league board shows who kept calibrated width.
hook: Weekly small-group ritual.
risk: League pressure may spur obsessive checking.
panel_note: Weekly coverage league on calibrated width

name: Division Ladder Weekly + Sweet Spot Zone meta
loop: Thirty-player divisions play one 3-minute set of eight charts per week; top five promote, bottom five drop, scores normalized to the division. Meta from PR-022: Drag two handles to bracket the end price; the reveal shows whether the real path stayed inside; coverage over many cards is checked against your stated confidence.
hook: One focused session a week, clear stakes, no daily pressure.
risk: Rank_vs_field punishes quiet divisions; use bounded zero-sum. | Interval jargon is a barrier; use plain words like likely range.
panel_note: Weekly 3-min divisions with coverage scoring; tap input mismatch

name: Morning Pages
loop: Journaling game: write a one-line reason before each forecast, and the end screen groups your reasons by calibration to reveal which work.
hook: Self-knowledge loop builds personal insight.
risk: Free text may contain personal data or advice.
panel_note: Free-text reasons need moderation and could carry advice

loop: Journaling game: write a one-line reason before each forecast, and the end screen groups your reasons by calibration to reveal which work.
hook: Self-knowledge loop builds personal insight.

name: Boss Gap Night / Seeded Daily Dungeon
loop: Every fifth room is a boss: an overnight gap. Set a probability for gap direction; log scoring means a confident miss deals huge damage to your health bar.
hook: Boss rooms teach tail-risk in a memorable moment. | Shared seed makes water-cooler comparisons possible.
risk: Log loss is hard to explain; needs simple health-bar framing. | Leaderboard pressure; keep rank out of verified-record surfaces.
panel_note: Boss gap with log health bar; coherent and clear

name: Dark Pattern Free + Seasonal Mastery Trials meta
loop: A short branching story of a paper trader; each choice is a forecast with a probability, and the story reflects calibration, not profit. Meta from LS-092: Pass weekly trials to hold a mastery level for the season: three trials on calibration, range honesty and bias; failing just means retrying next week.
hook: Narrative framing sticks without gambling cues.
risk: Story realism could imply advice; fictional chars only. | Low risk; ensure retry is unlimited but time-limited.
panel_note: Weekly mastery trials with unlimited retry; calm

name: Bear Season + Week Season Descent meta
loop: Themed season sampling falling-market windows; most players start biased toward up, so well-calibrated downside awareness climbs the table. Meta from RG-064: Seven daily seeded runs form a week season; your rating is the median of your best five days, so one bad run is forgiven.
hook: Theme exposes a common bias in your own record.
risk: May tilt toward fear; add a balanced bull season next. | Daily cadence can build habit pressure.
panel_note: Median-of-best-five forgives bad days; bear theme exposes up-bias

name: Sixty Second Sage
loop: Log-score blitz: ten masked charts in one minute, where overconfident wrong answers cost heavily and fifty-fifty hedges are safe.
hook: Harsh log scoring creates memorable lessons.
risk: Log loss is opaque; needs plain-language explanation.
panel_note: Ten charts in 60s tight; log harsh but clear

name: Narrow Path Bridge / Rookie Tutorial Crawl
loop: A bridge narrows with each room. Drag your forecast range; width must fit the bridge to stay up, so you learn to be both calibrated and sharp.
hook: Visual metaphor for sharpness versus coverage. | Gentle onboarding.
risk: Synthetic data must be labelled. | Low.
panel_note: Bridge teaches calibrated sharpness; 240s long

name: Three Bar Mystery
loop: You see three candles of a masked path and set a probability for the fourth closing higher; the answer and your Brier score unlock after you lock in.
hook: A one-minute puzzle that teaches calibrated probability.
risk: Brier score is jargon; need plain wording like closeness score.
panel_note: One-minute puzzle, but three candles are near coin flips
